<!-- pr-reviewer: 1902ca0547a08d963cb9b7d17412e3a4d769583d -->
Reviewed head 1902ca0547a08d963cb9b7d17412e3a4d769583d. Result: clean.
This PR turns the red main green: the four #2762 frame-cost tests pass at
this head.

Read of the law:
- `merge_hole` now tries the walk vertices first, nearest first, and the
  computed ray hits last. A bridge between two existing vertices adds no
  point, so the ear clipper cannot read a bridge point as strictly inside.
  The candidate checks (no proper crossing, on material) are unchanged; a
  bridge is still never a guess. Keeping the ray hits as the last resort
  is right: Eberly's construction shows a vertex is visible when the ray
  hits, so the hits only cover what no vertex can bridge.
- The distance comparator returns Equal on a NaN pair (no unwrap panic on
  the user path), and `p.x >= r.x` is false for NaN, so a NaN coordinate
  drops the candidate; the walk then refuses with `GeoError`, never a
  silent partial fill.
- The pin `region_triangles_bridge_a_hole_to_a_steep_edge` uses fig8's own
  coordinates, checks the area sum and 4000 inside/outside samples, and
  fails on the old code with a silent 1814 of 2223 area loss. Good - it
  pins the defect, not just the fix.
- The decision file names the drop of the helper-change and the epsilon
  options, and names the `dive_room` effect. The dive point may move for a
  holed region; each candidate is still checked with `contains` and
  `boundary_clears`. That is the right reading of the safety floor.

Gate, run here on this head (it contains current main; trial-merge trivial):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --lib`: 49 passed, 0 failed.
- `--test geo2d`: 16 passed, 0 failed (incl. the new pin).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1252 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. The
  four frame-cost tests of #2762 are green here.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Notes, non-blocking:
- The author's batch tier (golden CL/G-code suites) had not posted its
  result comment when this review ran. My targeted gate is green; the
  goldens ride the merge-time batch.
- `geo2d.rs` is 766 lines, over the 400-line file law before this change.
  The split is owed work, not part of this fix: file it `P7` if no issue
  covers it.
- This PR is a draft; it goes ready by its author or the merging session.

Laws obeyed: one concern (bridge candidate order), pin in the crate that
owns the code, decision file present, Changelog line given, `Fixes #2762`.
